summary: The paper explores automatic paraphrase identification using a fine-tuned Sentence-BERT model. By developing a COVID-19 news corpus from CNN and Yahoo News, the authors demonstrate Sentence-BERT's superior efficiency and speed over standard BERT. The implemented algorithm achieves 77% precision, effectively classifying semantically similar sentences while significantly reducing computational processing time for large text datasets.
keywords: Sentence-BERT, Paraphrase identification, Semantic similarity, COVID-19 corpus, NLP
topics: Computational Linguistics, Machine Learning, Information Retrieval
